# Peak Care AI

> Operations-first AI for independent hotels and hotel groups. Most direct bookings aren't lost on price, they're lost on speed: the 9pm enquiry that gets a next-afternoon reply loses the guest to the OTA tab they had open next to it. Peak Care AI drafts the first response in seconds — direct enquiries, review replies, pre-arrival messages, missed calls, quote follow-ups — a person still reads the tone and hits send. AI visibility (GEO/schema/structured data) is the natural next step once response speed is solved. Start with a free OTA Commission Check. Serving hotels across Europe (DACH, Western Europe, the Balkans and Bulgaria). EU AI Act and GDPR handled as the foundation, not the headline.

Peak Care AI (peakcareai.com) helps independent hotels and small groups adopt AI that pays off in daily operations — not hype, not a compliance-fear pitch. We start from the operation: where AI can lift direct bookings, cut OTA dependency, take load off the team and keep guest communication fast and on-brand. Led by Andreas Donner (Dipl.-Ing., background in engineering, construction, project management and hospitality operations). EU AI Act and GDPR are built in as a safe foundation.

## Core offers
- [Hotel AI Readiness Audit](https://peakcareai.com/hotel-ai-readiness-check): A free, practical assessment for independent hotels — where AI can reduce workload and lift revenue, where Shadow AI already exists, and which first steps are realistic. This is the door-opener.
- [AI Offer & Guest Communication Assistant](https://peakcareai.com/ai-offer-assistant-hotels): AI-supported workflows to answer enquiries, prepare offers and handle guest communication faster and more consistently.
- [Services](https://peakcareai.com/services): The full range — readiness assessment, guest-communication AI, internal workflow automation, AI literacy/team enablement.
- [Corporate AI](https://peakcareai.com/corporate-ai): AI governance and enablement for larger hospitality and service organisations.

## Who we serve
- Independent hotels and small hotel groups across Europe — DACH, Western Europe, the Balkans and Bulgaria (dual-geo: the Balkans and Bulgaria are equal target markets, not an afterthought).

## Positioning
- Revenue and operations first: more direct bookings, less OTA commission, leaner workflows, better guest communication.
- Operations-first, not hype. EU AI Act and GDPR handled as the foundation.
